name: menu-button
description: A button that opens a menu rather than acting immediately. The pattern holds the button and the menu it opens: the rows' roles, roving focus and keys are the Menu and Menubar pattern the source page defers to, held here because nothing draws one without the other.

requires.roles.haspopup: aria-haspopup set to menu or true
requires.roles.expanded: aria-expanded set to true while the menu is open, false while closed
requires.keyboard.Enter: opens the menu and moves focus to its first item
requires.keyboard.Space: opens the menu and moves focus to its first item
requires.keyboard.Escape: closes the menu and returns focus to the button
requires.roles.item: menuitem, on every row the menu draws
requires.roles.separator: separator, on every divider the menu draws
requires.focus.roving: every row has tabindex -1 and focus moves between rows by key; a disabled row is skipped, and Tab closes the menu
requires.keyboard.ArrowDown: moves focus to the next enabled row, wrapping from the last to the first
requires.keyboard.ArrowUp: moves focus to the previous enabled row, wrapping from the first to the last
requires.keyboard.Home: moves focus to the first enabled row
requires.keyboard.End: moves focus to the last enabled row
requires.keyboard.TypeAhead: typing a character moves focus to the next enabled row whose label starts with it; characters typed in rapid succession match on the accumulated string
